arguments.subject: Dec. 1 ship-list decision: Evergreen and Northstar work
arguments.body:
The Dec. 1, 2023 ship-list decision did not authorize putting Evergreen enterprise scoping or Northstar board/investor packaging into engineering sprints.

Evergreen questions were to stay in the current admin-test thread as next-phase enterprise-readiness follow-up; Jake was to stick to current product facts, with Devon handling commercial/procurement framing. Northstar follow-up and board materials stayed with Morgan, Devon, and Anna—not a separate engineering packaging lane.

The narrow exception: engineering work is allowed only when it directly improves the actual product evidence (or is a narrowly needed product-evidence clarification). Otherwise, scoping and packaging remain outside sprint scope.
